Image objective uses model pixel reconstruction; audio creates feature masks
and sampled negatives; video randomly masks spatiotemporal positions.
The source fingerprint hashes source_receipt summaries, not the full manifest
or all selected content hashes. Equal summaries do not establish identical corpora.
Source-reviewed orchestration. Nested semantics remain open; no runtime acceptance
claimed. Entire modality_train module reviewed. Resume rejects changed summary
fingerprints but does not prove exact source-byte identity. Final artifacts are separate
writes. Provider model construction and library optimization internals remain nested; no
training or decoder was run.
